game.title: FlipBit

release-dates.release-date: 2026 — closed beta on Google Play, public launch coming soon

game.description: FlipBit is a one-button retro arcade runner. Bit, a little pixel creature, runs non-stop through a tunnel full of spikes and spinning saws. Tap the screen and gravity flips: Bit jumps from the floor to the ceiling and back. The game speeds up every second, so runs are short, tense and easy to replay.

history.text: FlipBit is the first mobile game from kdmonteal.studio, a one-person studio in Colombia. The goal was a game anyone can understand in one second and play in one-minute sessions, with the look and sound of old arcade cabinets.

history.header: A world that follows the calendar
history.text: The tunnel changes every month using the phone's date: New Year, Valentine's and Friendship Day, beach summer, kites in August, Halloween, Day of the Dead, Christmas and more. Players who come back each month always find something new.

The daily challenge builds the same level for every player on the same day. After each run, the "Challenge a friend" button shares the score with the challenge number, so friends can compare results without accounts or online servers.

features.feature: One-tap gameplay: flip gravity between floor and ceiling.
Spikes and spinning saws, with a speed that grows every second.
"Close call!" bonus points for grazing an obstacle.
Daily challenge: the same level for every player, every day.
36 cosmetic items for Bit (9 colors, 9 hats, 9 neck items, 9 costumes), all unlocked by playing. Nothing is for sale.
12 monthly themed worlds that follow the real calendar.
Pixel art, chiptune music and CRT screen effects.
Plays offline. No sign-up, no account.
